title: stop-check: reconcile the touched log against git state before blocking
description: The kernel's canonical false-positive fix: the Stop hook blocked on files already committed in governed commits, because the touched log outlives commits. Only still-dirty touched paths block now. gitutil gained toplevel() so porcelain answers are trusted only for the root they describe.
notes: Seeded from the change record. This is the corpus's false-positive exemplar: the class of miss the phase-6 exit criterion ('without unacceptable false positives') is measured against. The expected sets are identical in shape to hist-governance-sampler deliberately - two kernel changes should produce the same selection, and divergence between them under a future ranking change is itself a signal.
